legend.harmReduction.precision: Coordinates are located from addresses; a few are estimated positions (marked in the popup).
legend.harmReduction.needleRow: Health education station / needle vending machine / return bin
legend.harmReduction.needleNote: One site can offer several types of service; when filtering, it is shown if it matches any checked type. {precision} Source: Taiwan CDC (Ministry of Health and Welfare) clean-needle program site roster (2026-07-14), plus county/city health bureau lists.
legend.harmReduction.treatmentNote: 130 sites include the number of patients on maintenance treatment (Ministry of Health and Welfare monthly report, 2026-01–08). {precision} Source: Ministry of Health and Welfare list of designated drug-treatment and substitution-therapy facilities (2026-08-31), plus data.gov.tw 133353.
legend.harmReduction.selftestNote: Real-time stock is not included; call ahead before visiting. {precision} Source: Taiwan CDC (Ministry of Health and Welfare) HIV self-test outlets (snapshot 2026-10-06).
legend.harmReduction.hivTestingNote: {precision} Sources: Taiwan CDC (Ministry of Health and Welfare) anonymous testing facilities (2026-09-22), health bureaus and centers (2026-07-22), designated medical facilities and pharmacies (2026-07-15); Ministry of Health and Welfare LGBTQ+ health centers (2026-06-12).
legend.harmReduction.preventionRow: Drug abuse prevention centers in each county/city
legend.harmReduction.preventionNote: Ministry of Justice, data.gov.tw 13717 (2024-02-01) · Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
legend.harmReduction.alcoholRow: Designated alcohol-treatment, subsidy and DUI-assessment facilities
legend.harmReduction.alcoholNote: One facility can hold several roles; when filtering, it is shown if it matches any checked item. {precision} Source: Department of Mental and Oral Health, Ministry of Health and Welfare list (2026-08-07).
legend.harmReduction.prepRow: Hospitals and clinics offering publicly funded or self-paid PrEP
legend.harmReduction.prepNote: {precision} Source: Taiwan CDC (Ministry of Health and Welfare) list of PrEP service hospitals (2026-09-02).
legend.harmReduction.internetNote: Institution types are grouped by name, not an official classification; the source does not include Lienchiang County. {precision} Source: Ministry of Health and Welfare internet addiction treatment resource tables by county/city (2026-07-28).
legend.harmReduction.aftercareRow: Taiwan After-Care Association headquarters, branches and the Fujian After-Care Association
legend.harmReduction.aftercareNote: Data is the 2023-06 edition (Ministry of Justice, data.gov.tw 10060, not updated for 3 years) · Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
legend.harmReduction.smokingNote: {precision} Source: Health Promotion Administration, Ministry of Health and Welfare, contracted smoking cessation service providers (exported from the official website 2026-10-06).
legend.harmReduction.pharmacyRow: New Taipei anti-drug guardian stations / Kaohsiung community drug-prevention care stations
legend.harmReduction.pharmacyNote: New Taipei and Kaohsiung only (no open rosters for other counties/cities). New Taipei data.gov.tw 125302 (2026-08-07); Kaohsiung 107877 (2024 roster).
legend.harmReduction.condomNote: Kaohsiung, Hsinchu City, Pingtung and Chiayi City only (no open rosters for other counties/cities); a few points have items to be confirmed (marked in the popup). County/city data.gov.tw datasets (2023-08 to 2026-08).
legend.harmReduction.communityRow: Ministry of Health and Welfare therapeutic communities / community rehabilitation program providers
legend.harmReduction.communityNote: Coordinates are the organization's office, not the placement site; 2 sites with no location found are not drawn. Department of Mental and Oral Health, Ministry of Health and Welfare (2025-07-29).
legend.harmReduction.duiNote: A1 + A2 crashes for 2018–2025 (ROC 107–114); a crash is included if any party's cause is drunk driving (one point per crash); zoomed out, they appear as a heat zone. Can be compared with the alcohol-treatment / DUI-assessment facilities in the harm reduction group. National Police Agency, Ministry of the Interior · Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
